name: Dou dizhu
summary: Three-player Chinese shedding card game where two peasants team against a bidding landlord to empty their hand first.
rules_text: Shuffle 54 cards including two jokers and deal 17 each, leaving 3 face down. Players bid 1-3 for landlord in turns; higher bid wins, bidding 3 wins immediately, if all pass reshuffle. Highest bidder becomes landlord, takes the 3 extra cards and reveals them, then leads. Players aim to shed all cards. On your turn play a legal combination or pass: single, pair, triple, triple with kicker(s), straight of 5+, chained pairs of 3+ pairs, airplane of consecutive triples with optional wings, four-of-a-kind with two kickers, bomb of four of a kind, and rocket of both jokers. Type must match previous play except bombs and rocket which beat anything, rocket beats bomb. Rank is 3 low to Red Joker high, suits irrelevant. If two passes follow a play, the player who played last leads new round. First to empty hand wins; landlord wins alone, peasants win together if either empties.
